XVLU: Salok of Guru Arjan Dev Ji.
6KV1: Antari = in the mind. Aradhana = to remember. Gur nau = the Guru's Nam.
To remember the Guru within the mind, to repeat the Guru's Nam with the tongue,
Deep within yourself, worship the Guru in adoration, and with your tongue, chant the Guru's Name.
Within your mind, contemplate you on the Guru and with your tongue, utter the Guru's Name.
Let us perform the aradhana of the Gurus with the antahkaran; let us repeat the Nam of the Gurus with the tongue.
UJ8E: to behold the Guru with the eyes, to hear the Guru's Nam with the ears;
Let your eyes behold the True Guru, and let your ears hear the Guru's Name.
With yours eyes, behold the True Guru and with yours ears, hear the Guru's Name.
Let us take the darshan of the Satigurus with the eyes; let us hear the Nam of the Satigurus with the ears.
25PN: Seti = with. Ratia = being dyed, by loving.
if in this way we become dyed in (the love of) our own Guru, then a place is found in (Prabhu's) presence.
Attuned to the True Guru, you shall receive a place of honor in the Court of the Lord.
Being imbued with the True Guru, you shall find a seat in the Lord's court.
Because it is by loving the Satigurus alone that a place is found in the court of Vahiguru.
HEXW: O Nanak! Prabhu gives this gift to that man upon whom He shows mercy;
Says Nanak, this treasure is bestowed on those who are blessed with His Mercy.
Says Nanak, the Lord gives this commodity to him, on whom he showers His benediction.
Sri Guru Ji says: he upon whom Vahiguru Himself shows mercy, to him He gives such a (vathu) thing as the bhagti of the Guru.
3GLM: such men are called the highest in the world, (but such as these) are only very rare. ||1||
In the midst of the world, they are known as the most pious - they are rare indeed. ||1||
Rare, very rare, indeed, are such persons, who are said to be good men, in the world.
Such excellent persons, if they be (kadhiahi) picked out from the world, are but some rare few — the sense being, exceedingly few. ||1||
E6H0: Rakhanhari = by the Protector, by the (Prabhu) who protects. Ubarianu = He saved them.
The protecting Parmatma has Himself saved (from the vices),
O Savior Lord, save us and take us across.
The saviour has saved me and He Himself has redeemed me.
Those whom the protecting Guru has kept within His own shelter, those Akal Purakh has Himself rescued.
SMGX: Savarianu = He set them right. Manahu = from the mind.
and, having set them at the Guru's feet, He has set all their works right,
Falling at the feet of the Guru, our works are embellished with perfection.
Falling at the Guru's feet, my affairs have been adjusted.
Having placed them at the feet of the Gurus, Hari has set their works right.
17WB: those upon whom Prabhu Himself has been merciful — them He has not forgotten from His own mind,
You have become kind, merciful and compassionate; we do not forget You from our minds.
When the Lord Himself becomes compassionate, within my mind, I forget Him not.
Those upon whom Hari Himself has been merciful, them He has not forgotten from the mind.
XSPD: Bhavjalu = the world-ocean. Tarianu = He ferried them.
and them He has ferried across the world-ocean, (keeping them) in the company of the gurmukhs.
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, we are carried across the terrifying world-ocean.
In the society of the holy-men, I have crossed the life's dreadful ocean.
Having given them the satsang of the sadh jan, He has ferried them across (bhavjalu) the world.
67S7: Sakatu = broken off, separated. Bidarianu = He destroyed them.
Those who are broken off from His feet, who go on slandering, who are of foul conduct — them He has destroyed in an instant.
In an instant, You have destroyed the faithless cynics and slanderous enemies.
The apostates, slanderers and miscreants, the Lord, by has destroyed in an instant.
The sakats, the slanderers and the wicked He has destroyed in an instant.
N1Y0: In Nanak's mind too is the support of that Master,
That Lord and Master is my Anchor and Support; O Nanak, hold firm in your mind.
In his mind, Nanak has the mainstay of the Lord,
Sri Guru Ji says: keep the support of that True Master within the mind.

GDHS: by remembering whom happiness is obtained and all sorrows are removed. ||2||
Remembering Him in meditation, happiness comes, and all sorrows and pains simply vanish. ||2||
by remembering whom, peace is obtained and all the troubles vanish.
By remembering whom happiness comes about and all sorrows are removed. ||2|| ☬ They make supplication before Parmeshvar:
